list.name: profile_id
list.label: Profile
list.description: Selected Project Provider Profile. Metrics derives provider identity, fixed project labels, source query ownership, field bindings, and mapping version using this profile.

list.name: range_mode
list.label: Range Mode
list.description: Controls the provider fetch/cache range. Work Week mode uses Begin WW and End WW as the backend data authority; Date mode uses the Grafana time picker dates.

list.name: begin_ww
list.label: Begin WW
list.description: Start work week for provider fetch/cache in Work Week mode. In Date mode this value is ignored by the Metrics API.

list.name: end_ww
list.label: End WW
list.description: End work week for provider fetch/cache in Work Week mode. In Date mode this value is ignored by the Metrics API.

panels.title: Profile Status
panels.description: Selected profile scope labels, source access, and materialized data freshness for this dashboard.

panels.title: Provider Fetch / Cache Window
panels.description: Provider-side fetch/cache controls define the authoritative backend range. Hover the dashboard variables for exact range-mode behavior.

options.content: Provider-side fetch/cache range is controlled by Range Mode, Begin WW, and End WW. Date mode uses the browser time picker dates as backend begin/end dates.

panels.title: Display Time Window
panels.description: Grafana's time picker controls the visible chart window. Stock Grafana cannot hard-lock manual picker edits, so use Sync Range when switching WW values.

options.content: Display Time Window follows the Grafana time picker. Sync Range opens this dashboard with browser dates aligned to the selected provider range.

panels.title: Component Bugs by Area
panels.description: Current open bug backlog by component or area.

panels.title: Quality Chart Health
panels.description: Provider support state for first-wave quality charts.
